questions.question: How many operable commercial nuclear reactors exist worldwide as of 2024?
questions.explanation: According to nuclear monitoring bodies, approximately 440 commercial nuclear power reactors operate across roughly 32 countries.

questions.question: How many times does an average human heart beat across an 80-year lifespan?
questions.explanation: At a typical resting rate of roughly 70 beats per minute, an 80-year lifespan yields nearly 3 billion heartbeats.

questions.question: How many individual ants are alive on Earth at any given time according to global ecological surveys?
questions.explanation: A comprehensive 2022 survey analyzing 489 studies estimated roughly 20 quadrillion living ants worldwide.

questions.question: How many total humans are estimated to have ever been born throughout human history?
questions.explanation: Demographic models estimating human births from 190,000 BCE to the present day calculate roughly 117 billion people.

questions.question: How many total litres of water are held in all of Earth’s oceans combined?
questions.explanation: Earth’s ocean volume is approximately 1.332 billion cubic kilometres, which equals 1.332 sextillion litres of water.
questions.fermi_derivation: 3.61e8 km^2 ocean area * 3.68 km avg depth * 1e12 litres/km^3 = 1.33e21

questions.question: How many finished oil paintings did Vincent van Gogh produce during his entire decade-long artistic career?
questions.explanation: Museum catalogues raisonnés document approximately 900 finished oil paintings produced by Vincent van Gogh between 1881 and 1890.

questions.question: How many commercial passenger flights take off worldwide on a typical single day?
questions.explanation: Aviation trackers log roughly 100,000 to 110,000 commercial flights crossing global airspace each day.

questions.question: How many cells make up an average adult human body?
questions.explanation: A landmark 2013 review calculated approximately 37.2 trillion cells in a reference 70 kg human adult.

questions.question: How many living trees stand on planet Earth according to satellite and ground surveys?
questions.explanation: A global study combining forest inventories and satellite imagery mapped roughly 3.04 trillion trees.

questions.question: How many kilograms does the planet Earth weigh in total mass?
questions.explanation: Using Newton’s law of gravitation and orbital metrics, Earth’s mass is calculated to be 5.972 sextillion metric tons, or 5.972e24 kg.
questions.fermi_derivation: Volume 1.083e12 km^3 * avg density 5515 kg/m^3 = 5.97e24 kg

questions.question: How many independent sovereign countries are recognized members of the United Nations?
questions.explanation: The United Nations counts 193 member states, with South Sudan joining as the most recent member in 2011.
questions.fermi_derivation: Count of official UN charter signatories

questions.question: How many cups of brewed coffee are consumed worldwide each single day?
questions.explanation: Global industry organizations estimate that over 2 billion cups of coffee are drunk around the world each day.
questions.fermi_derivation: 1.5 billion adult coffee drinkers * 1.5 cups per day = 2.25e9

questions.question: How many individual grains of sand exist across all the beaches and deserts of Earth?
questions.explanation: Geologists estimate approximately 7.5 quintillion grains of sand across all global coastlines and sandy deserts.

questions.question: How many total query searches does Google handle on a single typical day worldwide?
questions.explanation: Industry estimates indicate Google processes approximately 8.5 billion search queries every day.
questions.fermi_derivation: 4.5 billion internet users * ~2 Google searches per day = 9.0e9

questions.question: How many stars are estimated to exist in the observable universe?
questions.explanation: Multiplying an estimated 2 trillion observable galaxies by an average of 100 to 500 billion stars per galaxy yields roughly 1 septillion stars.

questions.question: How many living languages are spoken around the world today as of 2024?
questions.explanation: Linguistic catalogues like Ethnologue document roughly 7,168 actively spoken languages worldwide.
questions.fermi_derivation: ~200 countries * avg ~35 regional and indigenous languages = ~7,000

questions.question: How many total registered motorized vehicles are in operation worldwide?
questions.explanation: Global automotive and transport agencies calculate that the worldwide motor vehicle fleet stands at roughly 1.47 billion cars and trucks.

questions.question: How many bacterial cells reside in and on a single human body?
questions.explanation: A 2016 microbiome study showed the human body carries approximately 38 trillion bacterial cells, primarily in the colon.
questions.fermi_derivation: 0.4 kg colonic bacteria * 1e11 bacteria per gram = 4.0e13

questions.question: How many seconds have elapsed since the Big Bang began 13.8 billion years ago?
questions.explanation: Multiplying 13.787 billion years by 31,557,600 seconds per tropical year yields roughly 435 quadrillion seconds.

questions.question: How many chickens are slaughtered globally for food each single year?
questions.explanation: FAO livestock data records that more than 70 billion chickens are raised and slaughtered each year worldwide.
questions.fermi_derivation: 8 billion humans * ~9 chickens eaten per person per year = 7.2e10

questions.question: How many days of food does a single honeybee colony consume in honey across a harsh winter?
questions.explanation: A healthy colony stores enough sealed honey to sustain the winter cluster for roughly 150 to 200 days without foraging.
questions.fermi_derivation: 6 months of non-foraging winter cluster = 180 days

questions.question: How many individual birds are estimated to inhabit Earth at any given time?
questions.explanation: A 2021 global census assessing 9,700 bird species estimated a total wild population of approximately 50 billion individual birds.

questions.question: How many pieces of Lego bricks have been manufactured since 1958?
questions.explanation: The Lego Group reports having produced over 1 trillion plastic bricks since modern production began.
questions.fermi_derivation: 65 years * ~17 billion bricks produced per year = 1.1e12

questions.question: How many total transistors were fabricated worldwide in the single year 2020?
questions.explanation: Semiconductor industry analyses calculate that global silicon foundries churned out roughly 13 sextillion transistors in 2020 alone.
questions.fermi_derivation: 1.5 billion smartphone chips * 10 billion transistors + servers/memory = ~1.3e22

questions.question: How many steps does a climber take to ascend from base camp to the summit of Mount Everest?
questions.explanation: GPS tracking and expedition logs record approximately 55,000 to 60,000 total steps to climb the standard South Col route.
questions.fermi_derivation: 3,484 m vertical gain / 0.06 m effective step gain in snow = 58,000

questions.question: How many active volcanoes have erupted on Earth during the Holocene epoch (past 11,700 years)?
questions.explanation: The Smithsonian Global Volcanism Program records approximately 1,350 subaerial volcanoes with documented Holocene eruptions.
questions.fermi_derivation: Known tectonic boundary volcanic arcs count = ~1,350

questions.question: How many emails are sent and received across the globe each day as of 2024?
questions.explanation: Market communication studies estimate that roughly 361 billion business and consumer emails are exchanged daily worldwide.
questions.fermi_derivation: 4.5 billion email accounts * ~80 emails per day = 3.6e11

questions.question: How many living humans currently occupy the planet Earth as of 2024?
questions.explanation: UN demographic estimates placed the global human population past the 8 billion milestone in late 2022, reaching 8.1 billion in 2024.

questions.question: How many individual viruses are estimated to exist on Earth?
questions.explanation: Biologists estimate Earth holds roughly 10^31 viral particles, making them the most numerically abundant biological entity on the planet.

questions.question: How many metric tons of plastic waste are generated globally in a single year?
questions.explanation: OECD reports indicate that the world generates approximately 380 to 400 million metric tons of plastic waste annually.
questions.fermi_derivation: 8 billion people * ~48 kg plastic waste per capita = 3.84e8 metric tons

questions.question: How many distinct species of mammals are recognized by taxonomists today?
questions.explanation: The Mammal Diversity Database records approximately 6,596 recognized extant and recently extinct mammalian species.

questions.question: How many barrels of crude oil does humanity consume worldwide in a single day?
questions.explanation: The International Energy Agency projects global oil demand at approximately 102 million barrels per day.

questions.question: How many synapses connect neurons inside an average adult human brain?
questions.explanation: Neuroscientists estimate that the human brain’s 86 billion neurons share roughly 100 to 150 trillion synaptic junctions.

questions.question: How many joules of energy does the Sun radiate into space in a single second?
questions.explanation: The Sun’s total solar luminosity is measured at 3.828 times 10 to the 26th power watts (joules per second).
questions.fermi_derivation: Solar constant at Earth (1361 W/m^2) * 4 * pi * (1.496e11 m)^2 = 3.83e26

questions.question: How many years ago was the Great Pyramid of Giza completed?
questions.explanation: Radiocarbon and historical chronologies place the completion of Pharaoh Khufu’s pyramid at approximately 2560 BCE, roughly 4,580 years ago.

questions.question: How many total bones are in an adult human skeleton?
questions.explanation: While infants are born with around 270 bones, skeletal fusion leaves an adult human with exactly 206 bones.

questions.question: How many passenger cars cross the Golden Gate Bridge in San Francisco on a typical day?
questions.explanation: Bridge district toll data records approximately 112,000 vehicles traversing the Golden Gate Bridge daily.
questions.fermi_derivation: 6 lanes * ~750 cars per lane per hour * 24 hours = 108,000

questions.question: How many photos are uploaded or shared across Instagram every single day?
questions.explanation: Data metrics from Meta estimate that users share roughly 95 million photos and videos to Instagram each day.
questions.fermi_derivation: 1 billion active users * ~0.1 posts per day = 1.0e8

questions.question: How many joules of kinetic energy were released by the Chicxulub asteroid impact that ended the Cretaceous period?
questions.explanation: Geophysical impact simulations calculate that the 10-kilometre asteroid delivered roughly 300 sextillion joules of energy upon impact.

questions.question: How many distinct base pairs make up the haploid human genome?
questions.explanation: The Human Genome Project determined that a single set of 23 human chromosomes comprises roughly 3.1 billion base pairs.
questions.fermi_derivation: 23 chromosomes * avg 135 million base pairs each = 3.1e9

questions.question: How many islands make up the full geographic archipelago of the Philippines?
questions.explanation: An updated hydrographic mapping survey by NAMRIA in 2016 revised the official Philippine island count to 7,641.

questions.question: How many text messages (SMS and RCS) are sent globally in a single day?
questions.explanation: Telecommunication reports estimate that approximately 23 billion cellular text messages are transmitted each day.
questions.fermi_derivation: 5.4 billion mobile subscribers * ~4 texts per day = 2.16e10

questions.question: How many total books are catalogued in the Library of Congress in Washington, D.C.?
questions.explanation: Of the 175 million total collection items in the Library of Congress, roughly 40 million are bound books.
questions.fermi_derivation: Annual acquisitions over 220 years = ~40 million books

questions.question: How many total lightning strikes hit Earth across an entire year?
questions.explanation: Satellite optical sensors log approximately 44 lightning flashes every second worldwide, totaling 1.4 billion strikes a year.

questions.question: How many water molecules are present in a single standard 8-ounce glass of water (approx 237 ml)?
questions.explanation: A 237-gram cup of water contains roughly 13.15 moles, which multiplies by Avogadro’s number to 7.9 septillion molecules.

questions.question: How many commercial passenger flights land and take off at London Heathrow Airport on a typical single day?
questions.explanation: Heathrow Airport operates at roughly 98% of its capped runway capacity, processing approximately 1,300 air transport movements each day.
questions.fermi_derivation: 2 runways * ~41 movements per hour * 16 operational hours = 1,312

questions.question: How many total words does an average English speaker speak aloud in a lifetime?
questions.explanation: At an average speaking rate of roughly 13,000 to 16,000 words per day across 70 speaking years, the lifetime total nears 370 million words.

questions.question: How many living domestic cattle populate farms across Earth as of 2024?
questions.explanation: Agricultural census statistics from the UN FAO record roughly 1.53 billion head of cattle globally.

questions.question: How many meters is the distance between planet Earth and the Moon at average apogee/perigee orbit?
questions.explanation: Laser retroreflectors left on the lunar surface measure the Moon’s mean semi-major orbital distance at 384,400 kilometres, or 3.844e8 meters.
questions.fermi_derivation: Orbital period 27.3 days via Kepler’s third law = 3.84e8 m

questions.question: How many total atoms make up a standard 1-carat cut diamond?
questions.explanation: One carat weighs exactly 200 milligrams of pure carbon, which equals roughly 0.0167 moles or 1.0 times 10 to the 22nd carbon atoms.

questions.question: How many commercial passenger airports operate scheduled airline services in the United States?
questions.explanation: The Federal Aviation Administration classifies roughly 508 US airports as commercial primary and secondary service facilities.
questions.fermi_derivation: 50 states * ~10 commercial hubs and regional airports = ~500

questions.question: How many days did the Apollo 11 mission take from launch at Cape Kennedy to splashdown in the Pacific Ocean?
questions.explanation: Apollo 11 launched on July 16, 1969, and splashed down on July 24, lasting exactly 8 days, 3 hours, and 18 minutes.
questions.fermi_derivation: 3 days out + 1 day lunar stay + 3 days return = ~8 days

questions.question: How many connected smartphone and cellular computing devices are currently active worldwide?
questions.explanation: GSMA telecommunication analytics report roughly 7.1 billion unique connected mobile handsets globally.
questions.fermi_derivation: 5.5 billion unique mobile subscribers * ~1.3 active devices each = 7.15e9

questions.question: How many red blood cells does a human body produce every single second to maintain equilibrium?
questions.explanation: Because red blood cells have a 120-day lifespan, bone marrow must continuously synthesize roughly 2.4 million new erythrocytes each second.

questions.question: How many total protons and neutrons exist in the planet Saturn?
questions.explanation: Saturn’s mass of 5.683 times 10 to the 26th kg, composed mostly of hydrogen and helium, equates to roughly 3.4 times 10 to the 53rd nucleons.

questions.question: How many subway stations are on the New York City Subway system?
questions.explanation: The MTA operates exactly 472 distinct subway stations across the five boroughs of New York City.
questions.fermi_derivation: Official transit authority station inventory count

questions.question: How many hamburgers does McDonald’s sell worldwide in a single day?
questions.explanation: Across more than 40,000 restaurant locations, corporate estimates indicate McDonald’s sells roughly 75 million burgers daily.

questions.question: How many total bicycles are estimated to be in use around the world?
questions.explanation: Global cycling organizations estimate that roughly one billion bicycles are in active ownership worldwide.

questions.question: How many individual krill swim in the Southern Ocean around Antarctica?
questions.explanation: Antarctic krill form one of the largest single-species animal biomasses on Earth, estimated at roughly 500 trillion individuals.
questions.fermi_derivation: 5e8 metric tons biomass / (1e-6 tons per krill) = 5.0e14

questions.question: How many joules of energy were released by the largest nuclear explosion in history (the Tsar Bomba)?
questions.explanation: Detonated in October 1961, the 50-megaton Tsar Bomba weapon released roughly 210 petajoules of explosive energy.

questions.question: How many commercial passenger ships are in the worldwide cruise ship fleet?
questions.explanation: The Cruise Lines International Association logs roughly 300 to 340 ocean-going cruise vessels worldwide.
questions.fermi_derivation: Major operators (Carnival, Royal Caribbean, NCL, MSC, boutique) fleet sum = ~320

questions.question: How many total words are contained in the English language edition of Wikipedia as of 2024?
questions.explanation: With roughly 6.8 million articles averaging 650 words each, English Wikipedia holds over 4.4 billion total words.

questions.question: How many total honeybees live in an average healthy commercial beehive at midsummer peak?
questions.explanation: At peak summer foraging, a productive Apis mellifera colony contains between 50,000 and 70,000 worker bees.
questions.fermi_derivation: 1 queen * 1,500 eggs/day * 40 day worker lifespan = 60,000 bees

questions.question: How many kilograms of carbon dioxide are emitted by all human activity annually worldwide as of 2023?
questions.explanation: Global carbon budgets record roughly 37.5 gigatons (37.5 trillion kilograms) of energy-related carbon dioxide emitted each year.

questions.question: How many kilograms does the supermassive black hole Sagittarius A* at the centre of our galaxy weigh?
questions.explanation: Stellar orbital measurements by the Event Horizon Telescope and Nobel laureates calculate Sagittarius A* at 4.15 million solar masses, or 8.26e36 kg.

questions.question: How many distinct physical keys are on a standard full-size modern computer keyboard?
questions.explanation: The standard ANSI layout for IBM-compatible desktop keyboards includes exactly 104 mechanical keys.

questions.question: How many total passenger trips are taken on public transit buses worldwide each day?
questions.explanation: UITP transit associations calculate that urban bus networks transport over 500 million riders daily across world cities.
questions.fermi_derivation: 4.5 billion urban population * ~0.11 daily bus transit journeys = 5.0e8

questions.question: How many total litres of beer are brewed and consumed worldwide each year?
questions.explanation: BarthHaas global brewing reports indicate worldwide beer production reached roughly 1.89 billion hectolitres (189 billion litres).
questions.fermi_derivation: 5.5 billion adult population * ~34 litres per capita per year = 1.87e11

questions.question: How many total atoms of iron make up the metallic framework of the Eiffel Tower in Paris?
questions.explanation: With a wrought iron metallic mass of 7,300 metric tons, the monument contains approximately 7.87 times 10 to the 31st iron atoms.

questions.question: How many living individuals make up the global domestic cat population as of 2024?
questions.explanation: Veterinary and pet industry organizations estimate the global pet and stray cat population at approximately 600 million.
questions.fermi_derivation: 1 billion households * ~0.6 cats per household average = 6.0e8
